{"kind":"unit-test","claim":"Johnson.spectralLimit unfolds definitionally to an explicit closed formula in which z = 1-2u, m = 1-2α, σ = 1-2β-2γ and η = 1-2α+2β-2γ are substituted. This makes the affine definitions of the centered quantities and the shape of Λ, including √(1-z²) in the second denominator, visible for comparison with the paper. It does not check them against the paper itself.","lean":"theorem probe_spectralLimit_unfold (α β γ u : ℝ) :
    MetricCodes.Johnson.spectralLimit α β γ u =
      (((1 - 2*β - 2*γ) * (1 - 2*α + 2*β - 2*γ) - (1 - 2*α) * (1 - 2*u)^2)^2 /
        ((1 - 2*u)^2 * (1 - (1 - 2*α)^2) * (1 - (1 - 2*u)^2))) +
      (((1 - 2*u)^2 - (1 - 2*α + 2*β - 2*γ)^2) * ((1 - 2*β - 2*γ)^2 - (1 - 2*u)^2)) /
        ((1 - 2*u)^2 * (1 - (1 - 2*α)^2) * Real.sqrt (1 - (1 - 2*u)^2)) := by
  rfl","check_decls":["probe_spectralLimit_unfold"]}

parsed.claim: Johnson.spectralLimit unfolds definitionally to an explicit closed formula in which z = 1-2u, m = 1-2α, σ = 1-2β-2γ and η = 1-2α+2β-2γ are substituted. This makes the affine definitions of the centered quantities and the shape of Λ, including √(1-z²) in the second denominator, visible for comparison with the paper. It does not check them against the paper itself.
